summary: The universal empirical-superiority wording has explicit exceptions in Table A4, and the stated positive-distance prototype probability reverses nearest-prototype preference. Neither establishes failure of FS-SINR or provenance of a defective baseline run.
limitations: No author code executed or empirical reproduction.
Prototype baseline implementation/historical score sign unresolved; no invalid-baseline-run claim.
Many appendix plots, actual taxa lists, checkpoint provenance, speed measurements and external references not audited.

problems.claim: FS-SINR outperforms in every matched-metadata instance.
problems.location: p5 Section4.2; p19 TableA4; p6 Figure3
problems.result: Universal comparison false for reported means.
problems.counterevidence: Text-based gains and many other comparisons favor FS-SINR; no significance/rerun conclusion.
problems.correction: Qualify typical superiority with matched-information exceptions.

independent_verification.source_and_assumptions: Read p5 Section4.2 and directly viewed TableA4 on p19. Matched comparisons use S&T, identical number of location observations, and no text/image metadata.
independent_verification.decisive_reasoning: The 1-location row is FS0.50, Prototype0.54, Active0.53 and LE0.52; the50-location row is FS0.71 versus LE/SINR0.72. Therefore the all-instances dominance sentence fails for reported means. A0.04 gap cannot be a two-decimal rounding tie.
independent_verification.alternative_and_dependency: Text-conditioned rows and many other contexts favor FS-SINR; these exceptions do not overturn broad usefulness. No claim of statistical significance, metric reproducibility or historical corruption is justified.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor retained: qualify the universal wording with explicit exceptions, without removing the reported benefits.

problems.claim: Equation5 with positive cosine distances defines prototype presence probability.
problems.check: d+=0,d-=1; printed p+=0.268941; negative distance gives0.731059.
problems.counterevidence: May intend cosine similarity; baseline implementation not located, no historical run claim.
problems.impact: Local reproducibility/specification defect; benchmark effect unresolved.
problems.correction: Use negative distances or define positive cosine similarity; local algebra verified only.

independent_verification.source_and_assumptions: Read and viewed p25 Eq4-5 and the adjacent definition explicitly naming cosine distance. Nonzero unit presence/query vector(1,0), absence vector(0,1) gives distances0 and1; prototype means admit these values.
independent_verification.decisive_reasoning: Positive-distance softmax gives p_present=1/(1+e)=.268941 even at the positive prototype. Its derivative with respect to positive distance is positive. Negative distances give .731059, equal to positive cosine similarity after cancellation of the common constant.
independent_verification.alternative_and_dependency: A similarity-versus-distance naming error is a plausible benign reading. The frozen packet does not establish whether historical baseline runs used Eq5; the initial bounded source-search finding is retained, not expanded into a claim about all releases.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor specification defect retained; local sign or definition repair restores nearest-prototype preference, but historical baseline effects require additional evidence.
